hypothesis: Paired N=256 arm (same seeds, data range, architecture, controls and checkpoint spacing as the N=64 arm). At e <= 0.5 the matched seeds 56-58 formed 20-70 steps later at N=256 on the 0.1 bar. The half-final-margin measure suggested roughly equal timing. With the control ceiling removed at e in [0, 0.85], accel_step formation timing does not depend on steps_per_orbit: the persistent formation step at N=256 is within 20 steps of the same-seed N=64 step on both the 0.1-bar and half-final-margin measures.
expected_if_true: In at least 2 of 3 matched seeds (59, 60, 61), |N256 - N64| <= 20 steps on both the persistent 0.1-bar and half-final-margin formation steps, both read from the trajectory. Final N=256 accel_step margin >= 0.2.
expected_if_false: In all 3 matched seeds, N=256 forms >= 30 steps later than N=64 on both measures, so the delay is real and not a ceiling artifact. Any other pattern, including the two measures disagreeing, is inconclusive.
